label: shadcn/ui (React, Tailwind CSS)
summary: React components styled with Tailwind CSS utilities on top of shadcn/ui primitives. Design tokens are CSS custom properties in the Tailwind theme, so a token is used by name and changes with the theme.

elements.frame: A div, or the semantic element for its role (section, nav, header, main, ul). Add overflow-hidden when the frame clips.
elements.group: A div with no layout classes of its own.
elements.text: A p, span or heading (h1 to h6) chosen by its role. Use the text style's size, weight and line height from the theme.
elements.image: An img, or next/image in a Next.js project. Keep the fit as object-cover or object-contain.
elements.icon: The lucide-react icon of the same name. Set size and stroke width from the spec.
elements.vector: An inline svg with the path data from the spec.
elements.rect: A div with a background and rounded classes.
elements.ellipse: A div with rounded-full and a background.
elements.instance: The shadcn/ui component for the same purpose (Button, Card, Input, Badge, Dialog) when one exists; otherwise the component the spec lists under components.

layout.grid: grid with grid-cols-N, N being the frame's columns.
layout.none: relative on the frame; children with an absolute position are absolute with left and top set from x and y.
layout.gap: gap-N where N is the gap divided by 4, or gap-[Npx] when it is not a multiple of 4.
layout.padding: p-N for all sides, px-N py-N for two values, pt- pr- pb- pl- for four.
layout.justify: justify-start, justify-center, justify-end or justify-between for the main axis.
layout.align: items-start, items-center, items-end or items-stretch for the cross axis.
layout.fill: flex-1 along the parent's main axis, self-stretch or w-full across it.
layout.hug: No width or height class; the content decides (w-fit when the parent would stretch it).
layout.fixed: w-[Npx] h-[Npx], or the Tailwind step when the number is a multiple of 4.

tokens.reference: Use the token, never its value. A color token is bg-name, text-name or border-name when the theme defines it as --color-name; any other token is var(--property) in an arbitrary value, such as p-[var(--spacing-4)].
tokens.naming: A token name's slashes become hyphens and its first word is the theme namespace: color/primary is --color-primary, radius/md is --radius-md, space/4 is --spacing-4. export_tokens with tailwind-v4 writes exactly these.
tokens.modes: Theme values such as Dark are the .dark class and other selectors in the exported file. Never branch on the theme in a component.

components: One React component per component in the spec, with its props as TypeScript props and its variants as a variant prop (cva). An instance is that component with the instance's props, not a copy of its layers. Put them in components/ and reuse an existing one before writing another.
rules: Follow the spec's sizes and spacing; do not round them to what looks close.
Use shadcn/ui primitives from @/components/ui before writing your own.
Style with Tailwind utilities and the theme's tokens. No hard-coded colors or pixel values that a token covers.
Keep the layer tree's structure unless the spec says a layer is only decoration.
A layer with notes in the spec carries instructions from the designer; follow them.
